text:
Asha (Finance): Heads up — ran a spot check on the March preview batch and found ~8 previews where the commitment/compute line items are missing from the generated invoice PDF. invoices show subtotal but no reserved capacity lines. example: invoice_preview_id=pp_abc123, customer=AcmeCo, draft_id=draft-2026-03-01-ACME.

billing-bot: preview_job pp_abc123 status=completed_with_warnings (orphan_line_ids=1) :warning:

Wes (Billing): ugh. are these only previews or did any full invoices generate?

Asha (Finance): only previews so far — I stopped the nightly finalization job when I saw the first couple. looks like join against commitments table returned NULL for legacy_line_id in several rows.

Priya (Revenue Ops): hold sends on the affected customers pls. Can you list affected account ids? I can flag them for CS so they don't get surprised.

Asha (Finance): affected: ACME-142, NORTE-338, LUCID-77, +5 others. pushing csv to #finance-private now.

Tom (Engineering): can you paste the preview job log lines? also any stack trace?

Asha (Finance): snippet from the preview runner log:
```
2026-03-01T03:12:09Z INFO preview_runner starting pp_abc123
2026-03-01T03:12:14Z WARN line_joiner missing join for legacy_line_id=commit-98765 customer=ACME-142
2026-03-01T03:12:14Z WARN line_joiner orphan_line_id=orphan-4321
2026-03-01T03:12:15Z INFO preview_job completed_with_warnings warnings=1
```

Tom (Engineering): looks like a data join issue. recent migration changed commitment.line_id -> commitment.legacy_id for older rows and the preview query still joins on line_id. quick check SQL:
```
SELECT p.* FROM preview_lines p
LEFT JOIN commitments c ON p.commitment_ref = c.line_id
WHERE c.line_id IS NULL AND p.commitment_ref IS NOT NULL LIMIT 5;
```

Wes (Billing): if it's that simple, is it safe to remap preview query to try legacy_id when line_id lookup fails? we need a short-term fix for previews and a longer plan for final invoices.

Tom (Engineering): yes we can do a fallback join. I'll open a small PR to the preview pipeline to attempt ON p.commitment_ref = c.line_id OR p.commitment_ref = c.legacy_id, and add a one-off backfill to map orphan_line_id -> commitment.id for affected previews. will add feature flag.

Priya (Revenue Ops): timeline? CS needs notice before we re-run previews.

Tom (Engineering): PR + deploy today (ETA 3h). then I'll re-run previews for the affected batch with the flag enabled.

Asha (Finance): thanks — once you re-run pls drop the regenerated preview PDFs to the S3 prefix and ping me. I'll validate 5 samples then signal hold-lift. Also please log the preview_job IDs so we can audit.

Wes (Billing): after confirmation we'll re-run finalization for only customers that look good. Priya please prepare a short customer note template in case any matched commitments changed amounts.

billing-bot: staging-runner:preview_replay started job=pp_replay_2781112222 by=Tom

Tom (Engineering): started replay now, monitoring. cc @Asha

Asha (Finance): great — thanks team. tagging this as ACTIONS: (1) Tom deploy fallback join + replay, (2) Priya prepare CS template, (3) Wes coordinate finalization gating.

Priya (Revenue Ops): on it. will draft and share in ~15m. :memo:

Wes (Billing): please add the replay job ids to the incident tracker so finance ops can reconcile later.

Asha (Finance): adding ticket to finance-ops board: FIN-1567.

Tom (Engineering): update: replay complete, job=pp_replay_2781112222 status=success, regenerated 8 previews. attaching a short diff of one invoice lines table join result for ACME-142 -> now shows commitment line (commit-98765) with amount 1200.

Asha (Finance): verified ACME-142 and 3 others. PDFs look correct. Priya, Wes — shall we lift hold for finalization?

Priya (Revenue Ops): hold lifted for cleared accounts only, still reviewing rest. will update FIN-1567 with the list.

Wes (Billing): good work. follow-up: Tom please schedule a cleanup backfill to fix legacy references in the commitments table and add a regression test so preview join handles both ids.

Tom (Engineering): yup scheduling backfill and adding regression.

Asha (Finance): closing the loop here once backfill + tests merged. thanks everyone.
